test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian cartoonist’s autobiography is titled ‘The Tunnel of Time’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Laxman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rasipuram Krishnaswami Laxman **was an **Indian cartoonist**, **illustrator**, and **humorist**.
 
• He is best known for his **creation "The Common Man" **and for his **daily cartoon strip**, **You Said It **in **The Times of India**, which started in **1951. R. K**.
 
• He was **born **on **24 October 1921**, in **Mysuru**.
 
• He **died on 26 January 2015**, at **Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital and Research Center, Pune**.
 
• He wrote **You Said it**, **Maalgudi Ki Kahaniyan**, **The best of Laxman, **and more books.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ajit Ninan **is an **Indian political cartoonist**, best known for **drawing the Centrestage series **of **cartoons in India, Today magazine **and **Ninan's World **in the **Times of India**. **Ninan lives **in **New Delhi**, where he works for the **Times of India**.
 
• **Ottupulackal Velukkuty Vijayan**, commonly known as **O. V. Vijayan**, was an **Indian author **and **cartoonist**, who was an **important figure **in **modern Malayalam language literature**.
 
• **Mario Miranda **popularly known as** Mario de Miranda **was an **Indian cartoonist **and **painter based **in **Loutolim **in the **Indian state of Goa.**
